sub_site: pancreatic cancer tumour and paired para-tumour pancreatic tissue

data_source.dataset: Xiangya Hospital cohort (survival analysis also re-used Riquelme et al. MDACC/JHH data)

evidence.quote: samples of tumor tissues and paired para-tumor normal tissues were collected from 53 patients who had undergone surgical resection in Xiangya Hospital
Microbial DNAs were isolated from 52 paired samples and 16S rDNA sequencing was performed.
After decontamination, 1079 ASVs were finally identified

notes: 52 paired tumour/adjacent samples sequenced (53 patients enrolled). No Methods section in main text (methods in supplement, not available): region, controls and decontamination procedure unknown; only 'After decontamination' stated. Survival analysis used published Riquelme et al. MDACC/JHH data (not extracted).
